svg.title: Booking records: give repeated roles consistent treatments
svg.desc: Only three text nodes in the Print workshop card change weight and fill to match equivalent roles in the Clay workshop card. Names become bold dark, dates regular dark, and references regular muted. All font sizes remain 20. Every value, position, card boundary, photo/crop, header, phone and lighting remains identical. Static fictional summary.
